shared_elements: low relief carving on stone surfaces
animals or creatures shown in profile
figures arranged in a row along a band
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief imagery organised into horizontal registers with repeated profile elements — A shows crouching quadrupeds, a bird-headed creature and a large long-necked bird plus banded hatching, while B shows a row of stylised trees above a stair flank with standing human figures in profile procession. Beyond the generic devices of profile figures and banded registers there is no shared specific motif: A's zoomorphic repertoire and abstract fringe motifs have no counterpart in B's human procession and conventionalised trees.}
